protocol.title: Liquid Biopsy and Therapeutic Response: Circulating Tumor Cell Cultures for Evaluation of Anticancer Treatment
protocol.platform: Integrated three-layer PDMS microfluidic device (continuous-flow, gradient generator + channel barrier + tapered microwell array)
protocol.cell_source: Primary circulating tumor cells (CTCs) from clinical whole blood; breast cancer patients
protocol.objective: Short-term primary CTC culture in tapered microwells, doxorubicin dose-response screening via 8-channel concentration gradient, and IC50 determination without pre-enrichment

layers: Topmost layer: tree-like serpentine gradient generator (PDMS); mixes two inlet flows to produce 8 output concentrations
Intermediate layer: channel barrier (aluminum mold, Whits Technologies); defines 8 parallel culture channels; prevents cross-contamination between concentration zones
Bottommost layer: custom multimicrowell array (PDMS); each channel contains ~1000 tapered elliptical microwells

microwell_geometry.fabrication_method: diffuser back-side lithography; SU-8 2100 resist (300 um), opal diffusing glass, Hg(Xe) arc lamp 12 mW/cm2 at 365 nm, 9 s exposure

gradient_generator.notes: Channel-0 outlet (0% drug) serves as vehicle control and viability normalisation reference. Gradient distribution confirmed by FITC dye fluorescence quantification and COMSOL simulation.

device.assembly: standard oxygen plasma bonding; device placed in 150-mm dish with PBS film to limit evaporation; incubated in humidified chamber
device.pdms_formulation: Sylgard 184 (Dow Corning), 10:1 prepolymer:curing agent, degassed, cured at 80 C for 1 h

culture_media.notes: Supplemented DMEM selected after optimization across medium conditions (fig. S18 of paper)

media_exchange.syringe: BD Luer-Lok 10 mL (Becton, Dickinson and Company)
media_exchange.pump: NE-1000, New Era Pump Systems Inc.

doxorubicin.working_dilution: 1 uL stock into 1 mL supplemented DMEM

cd45_apc.labels: leukocytes (CD45+); used to gate out WBCs
cd45_apc.notes: Only CD45- cells (green fluorescence) counted for clinical sample viability rate

imaging.image_processing: ImageJ (NIH); max-intensity merged Z-stacks; cropping and thresholding 8-150 um; repeated signals ruled out by comparison

culture_conditions.atmosphere_clinical: hypoxia, 1% O2 (mimics in vivo tumor microenvironment)
culture_conditions.dish: 150-mm dish with thin PBS film to limit evaporation
culture_conditions.notes: Clinical CTC samples develop clusters only under hypoxic conditions; MCF-7 cell line forms clusters under both normoxic and hypoxic conditions at high seeding concentrations

positivity_criteria.threshold: CTC-containing clusters in >=50% of microwells per channel
positivity_criteria.method: bright-field imaging at 10x magnification; grey-value plot profiles (ImageJ); low grey values (<0.5) within microwell region indicate dense cluster
positivity_criteria.negative_classification: cell debris or sparse monolayers; grey values consistently high

ic50_determination.normalisation: viability data normalised to results from lowest-drug channel (channel 0, vehicle control)
ic50_determination.ic50_definition: concentration at which curve passes through 50% normalised cell death (y axis)
ic50_determination.imaging: Z-stack confocal images of 25 microwells per channel; 15 um slices; max-intensity merge
ic50_determination.gating: only CD45- cells (green) considered for clinical samples
ic50_determination.notes: IC50 > 1 uM indicates drug tolerance or resistance (above maximum tested range). Posttreatment P2B29 showed higher IC50 vs pretreatment, suggesting onset of drug resistance.

steps.name: Blood collection and RBC lysis
steps.notes: Whole blood (10 mL equiv.) from EDTA vacutainer; lysed within 10 h of withdrawal; 3-5 min lysis at room temperature; retains nucleated cell fraction (WBCs + CTCs)

steps.name: PBS wash of nucleated cell fraction
steps.notes: Single PBS wash to remove residual lysis buffer and debris; nucleated cell pellet retained

steps.name: Cell seeding into microfluidic device
steps.notes: Nucleated cells resuspended in 1.6 mL supplemented DMEM; evenly distributed across 8 channels (~200 uL per channel); BioScript `mix` abstracts on-chip syringe-pump seeding event

steps.name: Day 0-3 incubation
steps.notes: Closed system in humidified chamber; 150-mm dish with PBS film; clinical samples under hypoxia

steps.name: Media exchange #1 (Day 3)
steps.notes: 150 uL withdrawn via syringe pump (infusion/withdrawal mode, 100 uL/min); 150 uL fresh supplemented DMEM added per channel; BioScript models as dispense + mix

steps.name: Day 11 culture positivity assessment
steps.method: bright-field imaging at 10x; grey-value plot profiles per microwell (ImageJ); combined scatterplots normalised to highest count per microwell
steps.positive_threshold: clusters in >=50% of microwells (~500 clusters per 1.25 mL blood)

steps.name: Pre-drug medium priming flush (Day 11)
steps.notes: 150 uL medium withdrawn per channel before drug loading; device briefly primed with fresh DMEM at 100 uL/min to clear existing medium prior to drug infusion

steps.name: Doxorubicin gradient preparation and infusion (Day 11)
steps.notes: Tree-like gradient generator simultaneously delivers 8 concentrations from 0% (DMEM vehicle) and 100% (DoxorubicinStock) inlets. BioScript models as 8 discrete dispenses + binary-tree mix operations. Loading must be carried out carefully to avoid drug influx upon reinsertion of tubings.

steps.name: 72-hour drug exposure incubation (Day 11-14)
steps.notes: Gradient concentration remains constant over time; evaporation limited by humidified chamber. Vehicle control (culture_ch0) and drug-treated channels (drug_all) incubated separately in BioScript representation.

steps.name: Day 14 - LIVE/DEAD in situ staining
steps.notes: Two separate stain dispenses (stainCtrl and stainDrug) required per BioScript single-use variable ownership rule. Vehicle control and drug-treated channels stained independently.

steps.name: Day 14 - Fluorescence detection and IC50 readout
detection_steps: Confocal Z-stack acquisition (25 microwells/channel, 15 um slices, max-intensity merge)
CD45- gating: only green-fluorescent (calcein-AM+, CD45-) cells counted per microwell
Viability % per channel normalised to vehicle control channel (channel 0)
IC50 extracted as drug concentration at 50% normalised cell death

duration_conversions.note: BioScript supports s and m duration tokens only; h token unsupported

known_compiler_behaviours.drain_to_dispose: `drain` in .bs source is lowered to `dispose()` in IR output; .bs source remains semantically correct
known_compiler_behaviours.true_branch_no_jump: true-branch blocks (bsbbif_N_t) do not emit unconditional jump in IR text; DOT edges resolve correctly
known_compiler_behaviours.heat_is_void: `heat` is void/in-place; fluid variable ownership not consumed by heat instructions

abstraction_notes.gradient_generator: 8-channel continuous-flow gradient generator abstracted as 8 discrete DoxorubicinStock dispenses + binary-tree mix operations; no native gradient primitive in BioScript
abstraction_notes.hypoxia: 1% O2 hypoxic chamber condition not expressible in BioScript; documented in comments only; encoded as heat at 37 C
abstraction_notes.media_exchange: Each 3-day media exchange cycle modelled as dispense SupplementedDMEM + mix with culture variable; fluid ownership re-assigned at each exchange
abstraction_notes.stain_split: Two separate stain dispense calls (stainCtrl, stainDrug) used to avoid single-variable double-consume ownership violation
abstraction_notes.viability_signal_scoping: viabilitySignal assigned and disposed entirely within the cluster-pass branch (BB2); never referenced on the cluster-fail path (BB3)

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: RBC lysis, PBS wash, cell seeding, Day 0-11 culture with 3 media exchanges, cluster detection

basic_blocks.label: clusterPass
basic_blocks.description: Pre-drug flush, doxorubicin gradient infusion, 72h exposure, LIVE/DEAD staining, viability detection gate

basic_blocks.label: clusterFail
basic_blocks.description: Culture negative; drain culture_d9; experiment ends

basic_blocks.label: clusterJoin
basic_blocks.description: PHI nodes for branch-diverged variables; dispose clusterSignal; NOP

basic_blocks.label: viabilityPass
basic_blocks.description: Valid LIVE/DEAD signal; dispose stained_ctrl, stained_drug, viabilitySignal

basic_blocks.label: viabilityFail
basic_blocks.description: Staining/imaging failure; drain stained_ctrl, stained_drug; dispose viabilitySignal
